basis: The chart's y-axis is inverted (0 at the top, 8 at the bottom), meaning the lowest vertical position on the page corresponds to the highest value. The 2018 marker is at the lowest vertical position in the series (approximately 8.8), which represents the peak value. The 2010 marker is at the highest vertical position (closest to the top), representing the lowest value (approximately 8.1). Therefore, 2018 is the peak-burden year.
option_label: Escalate 2018 for annual mortality peak follow-up
